reviews.title: Launch week
reviews.headline: Market Monitor rebuilt from a single alert script into a monitoring and research system, with reliable timings and daily development.
points: Alerts now run at exact times (7 checks each weekday) instead of about 5 hours late
New Research page, nightly scan of all S&P 500 and FTSE 100 companies, and a Trends page for AI, tech and growth themes
Track record, score history, earnings reactions and urgent crash-watch alerts added
Daily research-and-build sessions start on Monday 2 November
